# 03 — API Specification
**Base URL:** `/api/v1/` · **Format:** JSON · **Auth:** `Authorization: Token <key>` (`Bearer <key>` also accepted)
**Live docs:** `/api/docs/` (Swagger, generated by drf-spectacular)

---

## 1. Auth (how login works)

**Method:** DRF Token Authentication: simple, built into DRF, no extra library.

1. Frontend sends username + password to `POST /auth/login/`.
2. Backend checks them and returns a **token** (a long random string) + user info.
3. Frontend stores the token (localStorage) and sends it on every request:
   `Authorization: Token 9944b09199c62bcf9418ad846dd0e4bbdfc6ee4b`
4. `POST /auth/logout/` deletes the token.
5. Tokens **expire after 7 days** (`AUTH_TOKEN_TTL_HOURS`). An expired token gets `401 NOT_AUTHENTICATED` ("Your session has expired…"), so on any 401 the frontend should send the user to the login screen.
6. Login, password change and password reset are **rate-limited** (10 per minute per IP by default, `AUTH_THROTTLE_RATE`). Over the limit → `429 THROTTLED`.

**Forgot password flow:** `POST /auth/password/reset/` with an email → the user gets an email with a link to
`<FRONTEND_URL>/reset-password?uid=...&token=...` → the frontend's `/reset-password` page reads `uid` + `token`
from the URL, asks for a new password, and calls `POST /auth/password/reset/confirm/`. Locally (no SMTP set),
the email is printed in the backend console/logs instead of being sent.

Demo accounts are created by the seed script (see `05_SEED_DATA_SPEC.md`). The frontend can show **quick-login buttons** ("Login as Commander Osei") that call the same endpoint with the demo credentials.

### Roles & permissions

| Role | Who | Can |
|---|---|---|
| `CREW` | Astronaut | Read/write **own** checks & daily logs; read own body map, trends, engagement |
| `MEDICAL_OFFICER` | Astronaut with medical duty | Everything CREW can, **for the whole crew**; crew overview; cabin logs write |
| `FLIGHT_SURGEON` | Doctor on Earth | **Read-only** everything; weekly report |
| `ADMIN` | Team / demo | Everything |

Shared permission helper: `can_view_astronaut(user, astronaut)` and `can_edit_astronaut(user, astronaut)`.
CREW accessing someone else's data → `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`.

## 2. Endpoint Summary

| # | Method | Path | Roles | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | POST | `/auth/login/` | public | Get token |
| A2 | POST | `/auth/logout/` | any | Delete token |
| A3 | GET | `/auth/me/` | any | Current user + linked astronaut |
| A4 | PATCH | `/auth/me/` | any | Update own email / first_name / last_name |
| A5 | POST | `/auth/password/change/` | any | Change password (returns a new token) |
| A6 | POST | `/auth/password/reset/` | public | Forgot password: email a reset link |
| A7 | POST | `/auth/password/reset/confirm/` | public | Forgot password: set new password |
| U1 | GET | `/auth/users/?role=&is_active=&search=` | ADMIN | List users |
| U2 | POST | `/auth/users/` | ADMIN | Create user (password, or email invite) |
| U3 | GET | `/auth/users/{id}/` | ADMIN | One user |
| U4 | PATCH | `/auth/users/{id}/` | ADMIN | Edit user (role, astronaut, password, is_active…) |
| U5 | DELETE | `/auth/users/{id}/` | ADMIN | Deactivate (not delete) |
| H1 | GET | `/api/health/` (outside v1) | public | `{"status","database","cache"}`, 200 or 503 |
| M1 | GET | `/missions/active/` | any | Active mission + today's mission day |
| C1 | GET | `/astronauts/` | any* | Crew list with latest status |
| C2 | GET | `/astronauts/{id}/` | view | One astronaut |
| C3 | GET | `/astronauts/{id}/baseline/` | view | Baseline values |
| V1 | POST | `/checks/` | edit | **Submit vision test → returns assessment** |
| V2 | GET | `/checks/?astronaut={id}&from=&to=&include_baseline=` | view | Check history |
| V3 | GET | `/checks/{id}/` | view | One check + assessment |
| D1 | POST | `/daily-logs/` | edit | Upsert vitals/lifestyle for a day |
| D2 | GET | `/daily-logs/?astronaut={id}&from=&to=` | view | Daily log history |
| E1 | POST | `/cabin-logs/` | MO, ADMIN | Upsert cabin CO₂ for a day |
| E2 | GET | `/cabin-logs/?from=&to=` | any | Cabin history |
| R1 | GET | `/astronauts/{id}/body-map/` | view | Body map statuses |
| R2 | GET | `/astronauts/{id}/trends/?days=90` | view | Chart series |
| R3 | GET | `/astronauts/{id}/engagement/` | view | Streak, badges, next test due |
| R4 | GET | `/crew/overview/` | MO, FS, ADMIN | Whole-crew dashboard |
| R5 | GET | `/reports/weekly/?week_ending=YYYY-MM-DD` | MO, FS, ADMIN | Earth report |

\* CREW sees the crew list (names + status colour) but only their own details.

## 3. Endpoint Details

### A1 `POST /auth/login/`
Request
```json
{ "username": "osei", "password": "demo-password" }
```
200
```json
{
  "token": "9944b09199c62bcf9418ad846dd0e4bbdfc6ee4b",
  "user": {
    "id": 2, "username": "osei", "role": "CREW",
    "display_name": "Cmdr. Ama Osei",
    "astronaut_id": 1,
    "email": "osei@example.com", "first_name": "Ama", "last_name": "Osei"
  }
}
```
400 `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` (wrong username/password, or account disabled) · 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` (missing fields) · 429 `THROTTLED`

`display_name`: astronauts → crew-role title + full name ("Cmdr. Ama Osei", "Pilot Kofi Mensah"); flight surgeon → "Dr. " + name; others → name or username. `astronaut_id` is null for flight surgeons and admins.

### A2 `POST /auth/logout/`
204, no body. The token stops working everywhere.

### A3 `GET /auth/me/`
200: same `user` object as above. 401 without a valid token.

### A4 `PATCH /auth/me/`
Request (any subset): `{ "email": "osei@example.com", "first_name": "Ama", "last_name": "Osei" }`
200: updated `user` object. Other fields (`role`, `username`, `astronaut_id`) are read-only and ignored.

### A5 `POST /auth/password/change/`
Request: `{ "old_password": "...", "new_password": "..." }`
200: `{ "token": "<new token>" }`. **Old tokens stop working**; the frontend must save the new one.
400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with `details.old_password` (wrong current password) or `details.new_password` (too short, too common, all numbers, too similar to username).

### A6 `POST /auth/password/reset/`
Request: `{ "email": "osei@example.com" }`
200 always (even for unknown emails): `{ "detail": "If an account uses that email, we sent a link to reset the password." }`

### A7 `POST /auth/password/reset/confirm/`
Request: `{ "uid": "Mg", "token": "c9x1k2-...", "new_password": "..." }` (uid + token come from the email link)
200: `{ "detail": "Password updated. Please log in." }`. The link works **once** and expires after 1 hour; all the user's tokens are revoked.
400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with `details.token` (bad/used/expired link) or `details.new_password` (weak password).

### U1–U5 `/auth/users/` (user management, ADMIN only; others get 403)
There is **no public sign-up**: every account is tied to an astronaut's health data, so admins create accounts.
User object = the A1 `user` object + `is_active`, `last_login`, `date_joined`.

U2 `POST /auth/users/` request:
```json
{ "username": "osei", "role": "CREW", "astronaut_id": 1,
  "email": "osei@example.com", "first_name": "Ama", "last_name": "Osei" }
```
- With `password` → set directly. Without `password` → `email` is required and the user gets an **invite email**
  with the same `/reset-password?uid=&token=` link as A6/A7, so they choose their own password.
- Rules (400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`): CREW/MEDICAL_OFFICER need `astronaut_id`; FLIGHT_SURGEON must not have one;
  one account per astronaut; username unique; password rules as A5.

U4 `PATCH`: any field. Setting `password` or `is_active: false` logs the user out everywhere. Admins can't
deactivate themselves or drop their own ADMIN role.
U5 `DELETE` → 204. Sets `is_active: false` (account and health data kept). Undo with PATCH `is_active: true`.

> **Swagger tip:** in **Authorize**, paste only the token. The API accepts both `Token <key>` and `Bearer <key>`.

### M1 `GET /missions/active/`
```json
{
  "id": 1, "name": "Ares Transit 1", "environment": "TRANSIT",
  "gravity_g": 0.0, "start_date": "2026-08-15",
  "mission_day_today": 92, "planned_duration_days": 900
}
```
409 `NO_ACTIVE_MISSION` if no mission is marked active.

### C1 `GET /astronauts/`
```json
[
  {
    "id": 1, "full_name": "Ama Osei", "call_sign": "Osei",
    "crew_role": "COMMANDER", "is_medical_officer": false,
    "latest_status": {
      "level": "RED", "mission_day": 91,
      "headline": "Left eye near vision 2 lines below normal",
      "next_test_due": "2026-11-16"
    }
  }
]
```
`latest_status` is null if no scored check yet. `headline` = the first reason of the latest assessment.
Lists your own mission's crew (flight surgeon/admin: the active mission). A **CREW** user gets a crewmate's
`level` and `mission_day` only (`headline` and `next_test_due` are null for others).

### C2 `GET /astronauts/{id}/`
The C1 item plus `display_name`, `mission`, `avatar_url`, `test_interval_days`. 403 if not allowed, 404 if unknown.

### C3 `GET /astronauts/{id}/baseline/`
```json
{
  "near_vision_left": 8.0, "near_vision_right": 8.33,
  "contrast_left": 6.0, "contrast_right": 6.0,
  "checks_used": 3, "updated_at": "2026-08-05T10:00:00Z"
}
```
404 `NO_BASELINE` if none.

### V1 `POST /checks/`: the most important endpoint
Request
```json
{
  "astronaut": 1,
  "is_baseline": false,
  "taken_at": "2026-11-14T09:30:00Z",
  "near_vision_left": 6, "near_vision_right": 8,
  "contrast_left": 5, "contrast_right": 6,
  "amsler_left": [[3,4],[3,5]], "amsler_right": [],
  "headache": 2, "eye_pressure": 1, "blur": 2,
  "distance_ok": true,
  "notes": ""
}
```
- `taken_at` optional (default now). `distance_ok`, `notes` optional.
- Validation: ranges from schema; amsler cells 0–9, no duplicates.

201 (scored check)
```json
{
  "check": { "id": 57, "mission_day": 92, "...": "all submitted fields" },
  "assessment": {
    "level": "RED",
    "worse_eye": "LEFT",
    "near_drift_left": 2.0, "near_drift_right": 0.33,
    "contrast_drift_left": 1.0, "contrast_drift_right": 0.0,
    "symptom_score": 5,
    "new_amsler_left": true, "new_amsler_right": false,
    "reasons": [
      "Left eye near vision is 2 lines below your normal.",
      "New wavy area seen on the left-eye grid."
    ],
    "actions": [
      { "code": "NOTIFY_MO_NOW", "text": "Tell the Crew Medical Officer now.", "priority": 1 },
      { "code": "ESCALATE_EARTH", "text": "A priority note will go to the flight surgeon.", "priority": 1 },
      { "code": "CHECK_CO2", "text": "Ask for a CO₂ scrubber check.", "priority": 2 },
      { "code": "RETEST_48H", "text": "Retest within 48 hours.", "priority": 2 }
    ],
    "env_insights": [
      { "factor": "CO2", "text": "This drop followed 5 days of high cabin CO₂.", "value": 4.6, "normal": 2.5 }
    ],
    "escalate_to_earth": true,
    "next_test_due": "2026-11-16"
  }
}
```
201 (baseline check): `assessment` is `null`, and the response includes the updated `baseline`.
The response always has all three keys `check`, `assessment`, `baseline` (one of the last two is null).
`check` = every request field plus `id`, `mission_day`, `created_at`; `assessment` also has an `id`.
403: crew submitting for another astronaut, or a flight surgeon (read-only).
409 `NO_BASELINE`: scored check submitted before any baseline exists.

### V2 `GET /checks/?astronaut=1&from=2026-08-01&to=2026-11-14`
List of `{ check, assessment }` objects, oldest first. `include_baseline=false` by default.
All filters optional; dates inclusive, matched on the day the test was taken. Without `astronaut`: everyone
you may see (crew: only yourself; Medical Officer: the crew). An astronaut you can't see → 403.

### V3 `GET /checks/{id}/`
One `{ check, assessment }`. 403 / 404 as above.

### D1 `POST /daily-logs/` (upsert on astronaut + date)
```json
{
  "astronaut": 1, "date": "2026-11-14",
  "resting_hr_bpm": 64, "systolic_mmhg": 118, "diastolic_mmhg": 76,
  "sleep_hours": 6.0, "mood": 3, "sodium_mg": 3400, "exercise_min": 90
}
```
All value fields optional; sending a field again overwrites it. Returns 200 (updated) or 201 (created) with the saved record **plus** `vitals_status`:
```json
"vitals_status": {
  "heart":  { "level": "GREEN", "text": "Resting heart rate normal." },
  "blood_pressure": { "level": "GREEN", "text": "Blood pressure normal." },
  "sleep":  { "level": "AMBER", "text": "6 h sleep: below target." },
  "mood":   { "level": "AMBER", "text": "Mood is lower than usual. Consider a talk with crew or family." }
}
```

### D2 `GET /daily-logs/?astronaut={id}&from=&to=`
List of saved records (same fields as D1, without `vitals_status`), oldest first. Filters as V2.

### E1 `POST /cabin-logs/` (upsert on mission + date)
```json
{ "date": "2026-11-14", "co2_mmhg": 4.6, "temperature_c": 22.5, "humidity_pct": 45 }
```
Mission = active mission. 201 created / 200 updated (only the fields you send change). Medical Officer or
admin only (others 403). 409 `NO_ACTIVE_MISSION` if none.

### E2 `GET /cabin-logs/?from=&to=`
Your mission's cabin logs (flight surgeon/admin: the active mission), oldest first. Each:
`{ "id", "mission", "date", "mission_day", "co2_mmhg", "temperature_c", "humidity_pct" }`.

> **Numbers:** decimals (`8.33`, `4.6`) are JSON numbers, not strings.

### R1 `GET /astronauts/{id}/body-map/`
Drives the clickable figure. Each part: status + info card text.
```json
{
  "astronaut_id": 1, "mission_day": 92,
  "parts": [
    {
      "part": "EYES", "level": "RED",
      "summary": "Left eye vision drifting. Test again within 48 h.",
      "last_updated": "2026-11-14T09:30:00Z",
      "info": {
        "function": "Your eyes focus light so you can see near and far.",
        "space_effect": "Without gravity, fluid shifts to the head and can press on the back of the eye (SANS).",
        "what_to_do": "Do the weekly eye test. Report blur or headaches early."
      },
      "action": { "label": "Start eye test", "route": "/test" }
    },
    { "part": "HEART", "level": "GREEN", "summary": "HR 64, BP 118/76", "...": "..." },
    { "part": "SLEEP", "level": "AMBER", "summary": "6.0 h last night", "...": "..." },
    { "part": "MIND",  "level": "AMBER", "summary": "Mood 3/5", "...": "..." }
  ]
}
```
Rules: EYES from latest Assessment; HEART = worse of heart & BP; SLEEP and MIND from latest DailyLog. No data → `level: "UNKNOWN"`. Info text is static (kept in `reports/content.py`).

As built (additions, nothing above changed):
- `?as_of=YYYY-MM-DD` (default today): the map as it was on that date, using only data up to then.
  The response echoes `as_of`.
- Each part uses the most recent daily log that **has** its values (a mood-only log doesn't blank SLEEP).
- Extra per-part fields: `guidance` (advice for the current level: the top action for EYES, the vitals rule
  text for the others; null when UNKNOWN) and `read_more_url` (the NASA risk page, docs/08 R1).
- `last_updated`: the eye test's `taken_at`; for HEART/SLEEP/MIND the start of the logged day (UTC); null if no data.
- Permissions as C2: crew only their own (403 otherwise).

### R2 `GET /astronauts/{id}/trends/?days=90`
Arrays ready for charts (one point per day where data exists).
```json
{
  "baseline": { "near_vision_left": 8.0, "near_vision_right": 8.33, "contrast_left": 6.0, "contrast_right": 6.0 },
  "vision": [
    { "date": "2026-08-21", "mission_day": 7, "near_vision_left": 8, "near_vision_right": 8,
      "contrast_left": 6, "contrast_right": 6, "level": "GREEN" }
  ],
  "cabin_co2": [ { "date": "2026-08-15", "mission_day": 1, "co2_mmhg": 2.4 } ],
  "daily": [ { "date": "2026-08-15", "mission_day": 1, "sodium_mg": 3100,
               "exercise_min": 120, "sleep_hours": 7.5, "mood": 4,
               "resting_hr_bpm": 62, "systolic_mmhg": 116, "diastolic_mmhg": 75 } ],
  "events": [ { "mission_day": 78, "type": "CO2_HIGH_START", "text": "Cabin CO₂ above normal" } ]
}
```

### R3 `GET /astronauts/{id}/engagement/` (gamification, computed)
```json
{
  "streak_weeks": 12,
  "tests_completed": 13,
  "next_test_due": "2026-11-16",
  "overdue": false,
  "badges": [
    { "code": "FIRST_TEST", "name": "First Look", "earned": true },
    { "code": "STREAK_4", "name": "Steady Eyes (4 weeks)", "earned": true },
    { "code": "STREAK_12", "name": "Clear Orbit (12 weeks)", "earned": true },
    { "code": "DAILY_LOG_30", "name": "30 Daily Logs", "earned": true },
    { "code": "EARLY_REPORTER", "name": "Reported symptoms early", "earned": false }
  ],
  "mission_progress": { "day": 92, "planned": 900, "pct": 10.2 }
}
```
Rules in `04_SCORING_RULES.md` §6.

### R4 `GET /crew/overview/`
```json
{
  "mission_day": 92,
  "cabin": { "co2_mmhg_today": 4.1, "co2_level": "AMBER", "co2_5day_avg": 4.6 },
  "crew": [
    { "astronaut_id": 1, "call_sign": "Osei", "eyes": "RED", "heart": "GREEN",
      "sleep": "GREEN", "mind": "GREEN", "overall": "RED",
      "headline": "Left eye 2 lines below normal", "overdue": false }
  ],
  "alerts": [
    { "astronaut_id": 1, "level": "RED", "text": "Osei: escalate to Earth", "created_at": "..." }
  ]
}
```
`overall` = worst of the four parts.

### R5 `GET /reports/weekly/?week_ending=2026-11-14`
Compact report for Earth. Default week_ending = today.
```json
{
  "mission": { "name": "Ares Transit 1", "day_range": [86, 92] },
  "generated_at": "2026-11-14T10:00:00Z",
  "crew_summary": [
    { "call_sign": "Osei", "eyes": "RED", "near_drift": { "left": 2.0, "right": 0.33 },
      "symptom_score": 5, "new_amsler": ["LEFT"], "escalated": true }
  ],
  "environment": { "co2_avg": 4.4, "co2_max": 5.0, "days_above_normal": 5 },
  "insights": [ "Osei: drop followed 5 days of high cabin CO₂." ],
  "recommendations_for_surgeon": [ "Review Osei's left-eye trend and Amsler grid." ]
}
```

---

## 4. Status Codes Used

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | OK / upsert updated |
| 201 | Created |
| 400 | `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` |
| 401 | `NOT_AUTHENTICATED` (missing/bad token) |
| 403 | `PERMISSION_DENIED` |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND`, `NO_BASELINE` (on baseline GET) |
| 409 | `NO_BASELINE` (on scored check POST) |
| 409 | `NO_ACTIVE_MISSION` (M1, E1, E2 when no mission is active) |
| 429 | `THROTTLED` (too many login / password attempts) |

All errors use the standard format in `01_SETUP_AND_CONVENTIONS.md`.

## 5. Contract Rule

This file is the **agreement with the frontend**. If you change a field name or shape, update this file and tell the frontend teammate. Swagger at `/api/docs/` must match this file.
